records.name: Cardell Dance Projects
records.summary: A dance group that also goes by Scrap Performance Group, on North Uber Street in Philadelphia. Its website would not load for us, so what it offers is not confirmed.
records.notes: Site failed twice with a TLS certificate name mismatch (served by a shared host), on both https and http. Not a bot check or 403. Retry later. Address on record is 726 N Uber St, 19130. Interest tag is the closest fit.

records.name: Chinese American Women's Sisterhood Society of Philadelphia
records.summary: A nonprofit that a third-party directory describes as a group supporting and empowering Chinese American women in Philadelphia. We found no website of its own and no recent activity.
records.notes: Only a third-party aggregator listing was found. It shows no officers, events or contact details. The open_to value is a placeholder until the group confirms how it takes members. Verify on IRS.gov or by searching the EIN. Address on record is 301 N 9th St, Suite 305, 19107.

records.name: Philadelphia Chamber Music Society
records.summary: A chamber music group based at 1528 Walnut Street in Center City. Its concert site returned an access error to our check, so its current concerts are not confirmed.
records.notes: Site returned HTTP 403 (listed under blocked). Concert series is the main activity, so the interest tag is the closest fit and not a match. Recheck by hand or from the Cultural Fund page. Address on record is 1528 Walnut Street, 19102.

Address on record is 1650 Arch St, Suite 2130, 19103. Contact on record: Samip Mallick (not copied here).

records.name: Black Music Preservation Inc
records.summary: A nonprofit that works to preserve Black music, based at 3418 North 18th Street in North Philadelphia. Its website page was not found, so its events and programs are not confirmed.
records.notes: Both the root domain and the www host returned HTTP 404. The summary comes from the group name only. Interest tag and audience are guesses. Check for a new domain or a Cultural Fund page before publishing.

records.name: Junk
records.notes: Brian Sanders' JUNK is a touring performance company (show Urban Scuba for 2026 to 2027). Its site offers tickets, donations, presenter info and a mailing list, but no classes, memberships or volunteer or community programs. Under the brief this is a company with no community program, so it is not_a_group. Revisit if it starts classes or volunteer roles. Site lists phone 267-406-6080 and email urbanscuba@gmail.com if needed later.

records.name: RAIR Inc.
records.summary: An arts organization at 7333 Milnor Street in the Northeast that runs an artist residency, public tours and community events, including a yearly event called Trash Bash.
records.what_you_do: Take a tour of the facility, volunteer through the site's Volunteer section, or come to a community event such as Trash Bash 2026.

cost.text: No cost listed for tours or events on the page

first_step.how: Visit the Volunteer section on rairphilly.org or email info@rairphilly.org to ask about the next tour or community event
first_step.basis: The site lists public tours, community events and a volunteer section, which is a clear way in

records.notes: Newest item is the Trash Bash 2026 poster, which has no date on the page, so status is probably_active from a working site with a 2026 event name. Mission and art form are not stated; the interest tag is the closest fit. Phone not listed.

records.name: Artsi
records.summary: A Philadelphia group that hosts live events, such as a listening night called The Listening Room, and lists its shows and past events on its own site.
records.what_you_do: Buy a ticket to a listed show, such as The Listening Room, or browse past events to see what the group runs.

first_step.how: Buy a ticket to The Listening Room through the link on artsiphilly.org/events
first_step.basis: Shows are sold to the public through a clear ticket link

records.notes: The Listening Room is dated October 24 with no year on the page, so status stays unknown. Ticket price not published. The email link on the page points to a placeholder, so the displayed email was used. Interest tag is the closest fit. Verify the year before publishing.

records.name: Fire Museum Presents
records.summary: A nonprofit listed at 2125 East York Street in the river wards. Its website only showed a loading screen to our check, so its programs are not confirmed.
records.notes: Site is JavaScript-rendered and stayed on Loading... on three tries (both www and bare domains). Interest tag is a guess from the name. Retry with a browser-rendering method before publishing. Address on record is 2125 E York St, 19125. Contact on record: Steven Tobin (not copied here).

records.name: Termite TV Collective
records.summary: A Philadelphia video and media art collective that makes experimental video, shows its work in galleries and screenings, and airs its shows on PhillyCAM. Its Places of Power project uses virtual and augmented reality to tell neighborhood stories.
records.what_you_do: See a free gallery show or screening, watch the collective's shows on PhillyCAM, or ask about its workshops and community projects.

cost.text: Gallery access was free at a past exhibition

first_step.how: Go to a free gallery show or screening, or write to the collective through termite.org to ask about workshops
first_step.basis: Past exhibitions and screenings were open to the public at no charge

records.notes: termite.org returned an empty page on five tries, so the summary and contacts rely on search results and the Cultural Fund record. Newest dated item found is an August 2025 installation at Cherry Street Pier, about 14 months old, so probably_active. No regular class schedule was found. Check termite.org again to confirm current workshops.

records.name: Ars Nova Workshop
records.summary: A nonprofit that presents live new jazz and improvised music in Philadelphia, mostly at the Solar Myth venue. It also runs a mentoring series and a podcast.
records.what_you_do: Buy a ticket to a listed show, join the mailing list for news, or visit the Volunteer page to see how to help at events.

first_step.how: Buy a ticket to an upcoming show through the event link on arsnovaworkshop.org, or join the mailing list
first_step.basis: Public concerts are sold with ticket links, so anyone can attend without membership

records.notes: Site lists concerts from late October to December 2026 with a Volunteer page that has no described roles. Ticket prices not shown in the summary, so cost is left out. Address on record is the office suite; the venue is Solar Myth.

notes: 12 batch groups handled. Verdicts: 11 publish, 1 not_a_group (Junk, a touring performance company with no class or volunteer program). Of the 11 publish records, 7 are unknown or probably_active with low confidence because their own sites were blocked, errored or empty, and their summaries rest only on the batch name or third-party listings; those need manual checks before they go live. Status active for Ars Nova Workshop and probably_active for Termite and RAIR. Artsi's event year is not on its page. Search budget fully used (2 of 2). Fetches used: 20, including repeated retries on the same sites. No logins, bot-check bypasses, or form submissions were attempted.
